_howToEdit: This file holds all the real game content. Edit the text, save, and push. No code changes needed.
Each category has exactly 5 tiles, in row order from top (row 1) to bottom (row 5).
"name" is the title shown on the board and the How to Play page; "short" is the label on the small example board. Aaja Nachle's "prompt" is the line shown before the song plays.
Image and MP3 file names refer to files in the assets folder, for example "fetch-1.jpg" means assets/fetch-1.jpg.

Fetch: "caption" is optional text shown under the picture. Hook Step: the song loops between "start" and "end" (minutes:seconds) until Stop is pressed; leave both as "" to loop the whole song. "answer" is optional; if filled in, a Reveal Answer button shows it.
Character: exactly 5 clues, from hardest to easiest. "image" is optional (leave it as "" for none).
Demo tiles on the How to Play page live in demo.json, not here.

tiles.plot: A reserved office clerk, whose marriage is devoid of affection, assumes a flamboyant disguise to participate in a dance competition alongside his unsuspecting wife. While she becomes captivated by his boisterous alter ego, she remains oblivious to the fact that the two men competing for her affection are, in reality, one and the same person. His elaborate deception soon forces him to confront whether love can flourish without being recognised for who he truly is.

A prominent industrialist’s insistence on familial tradition leads him to sever ties with his eldest son, whose choice of life partner defies the household’s expectations. The ensuing estrangement spans continents, leaving the younger heir to devise an elaborate reconciliation without revealing his true intentions. As the family’s younger generation grows up amid unresolved grievances, a carefully orchestrated reunion forces the patriarch to confront the consequences of his own inflexibility.

A landlord perpetually struggles to collect rent from two financially inept tenants, one of whom operates a failing garage while the other survives on precarious odd jobs. Their fortunes appear to change when a telephone operator accidentally connects them to a kidnapping negotiation involving a wealthy industrialist’s abducted granddaughter. Instead of alerting the authorities, the trio decide to impersonate the kidnappers and demand a share of the ransom. Their scheme spirals into chaos when the original abductors grow suspicious, a ransom exchange becomes increasingly complicated, and an innocent family’s desperation collides with the trio’s greed and incompetence.

A notorious con artist impersonates a celebrated filmmaker to persuade an unsuspecting village to participate in an elaborate cinematic deception. His actual objective, however, is to intercept a heavily guarded consignment of priceless diamonds aboard a moving train. With an ambitious actress, a gullible village, and an international film crew unknowingly caught in his scheme, he orchestrates an audacious spectacle in which fiction becomes the perfect disguise for a criminal enterprise.

A perpetually unemployed young man establishes an unconventional organisation dedicated to facilitating romantic unions, despite being spectacularly inept at resolving the complications of his own heart. His life takes an unexpected turn when he becomes enamoured with a young woman whose affections are irrevocably directed towards an expatriate she encountered overseas. Suppressing his own romantic inclinations, he undertakes the rather ill-advised mission of reuniting the two, only to become entangled in a labyrinth of mistaken identities, an influential father’s opposition, a botched abduction, and the machinations of a local criminal syndicate. As his self-appointed role as a benevolent matchmaker spirals into absurdity, he must confront the possibility that facilitating another man’s happiness may come at the expense of his own.

categories.name: Aaja Nachle
categories.prompt: Every team, send up one player who hasn't come up yet in this game.

clues: Bank receipts were my love language.
I was a fintech bro before the tech existed.
One journalist ended my career.
I once claimed I delivered a crore to the PM in a suitcase.
Risk hai toh ishq hai.
My career had a longer interval than most films.
I said nothing in my comeback film and won everything.
The internet promoted me to Lord before any director did.
I made dancing with a glass on my head a personality.
Aashram ka Baba.
Gujarati hoon, so naturally I started my own separate business.
Roommates? I prefer different buildings.
My country came in two pieces, like a bad IKEA delivery.
Nehru's frenemy, before frenemy was a word.
Every Pakistani wallet carries my face.
I'm an engineer, which explains all the U-turns.
Every ex takes me back.
I've taken the oath more times than most people take exams.
My party symbol is an arrow, but I never move in a straight line.
Bihar's longest-serving CM, from every side of the aisle.
My old employer dragged me to court over one sentence.
Mute button? Never heard of it.
I have eight guests and one speaking slot.
I run a Republic, but it's no democracy.
The nation wants to know... who I am.
